comparison.objective: Tip a pivoted rocker so an eccentric counterweight clears a stop and leave the beam settled on the opposite stop; candidate removes and recovers insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual articulated-fixture coordination across revolute joints and obstacles versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammer impulse control, manufactured-notch fracture, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Turn the counterweight past the blocking post while tipped, then release and settle on the new stop versus four clean fractures and physical tang containment with no coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both demand coordinated contact manipulation, but joint-state reconfiguration without fracture is a meaningfully different ability. No spec versions or final angular tolerances are provided.
